Looking to spice up your bathroom décor? At Tint a Car, we are your best bet as window film suppliers. Bathrooms are the one place in the house where you can get total privacy – whether it be to wind down, or just to take a moment from reality. It’s also the room in the house where you have a range of options to choose from and be creative with designs.

Get total privacy with the right window tint suppliers

Customisable Tints

Tint a Car offers a range of opaque, patterned and customisable tints. With options to customise the shade, print logos and adding graphics, we are the window film suppliers to go to. All of the films available at Tint a Car are suitable for use on interior or exteriors of windows.

This means even more flexibility for you to choose how to improve the look and feel of your home, office or shop front.

The Right Window Tint Suppliers

Having over 40 years of experience, Tint a Car are the right window tint suppliers for you. We are leading the way with home tinting technology, so you can be sure you are making the right choice.

Our staff all complete training and are knowledgeable to answer all your home tinting questions!
